_about: What's new: the RELEASED changes a member would notice, newest first, in plain words (src/ui/changelog.js draws them in a drawer from the dashboard). Only what is on main and switched on for people: nothing planned, nothing behind a switch the owner has not thrown, nothing that needs a server step that has not run. `id` is written into the device prefs blob (fms_studio_prefs_v1 `whatsNewSeen`) as the newest entry the reader has opened, so never reuse or rename one; add new entries at the TOP with a fresh id. Dates are the day it reached main.

entries.title: Beat colours that follow your scenes
items: Give a beat a colour, and the scenes it links show it on the Scene List and the beat board.
A beat's text and its linked scene's synopsis stay in step, whichever side you edit.

entries.title: Sticky notes beside your writing
items: Sticky notes open beside the Story path, the Scene List and the Screenplay Writer; pin one to a beat or a scene.
A short film's beat sheet keeps to its five beats.

entries.title: One list for every page
items: The menu in the side rail and the tabs on each page now show the same sections, in the same order.
Receipts print as one branded page.
A pass over the whole studio: clearer buttons, steadier tab strips and fixes on the writing, production and post pages.

entries.title: Final Draft and Fountain export
items: Export your screenplay as Final Draft (.fdx) or Fountain as well as PDF and Word.
The sync status says plainly what is saved where.
Backup and sync sit just above your account picture in the rail.

entries.title: Write on paper, analyse the script
items: Writing fields look like a page: dark ink on paper, in the screenplay face.
Script analysis is a tab of the Screenplay Writer, and the script pipeline fills only what is still blank.
The shot list can be reordered, and its PDF prints the columns you pick or storyboard sheets of four or six panels.

entries.title: Find and replace, index cards, Word files
items: Find and replace in the screenplay (Ctrl or Cmd + Shift + H).
Index cards on the Scene List.
Import and export Word (.docx) screenplays, and lock pages once a draft goes out.
Story is four steps: Idea, Characters & world, Beat Sheet, Synopsis.
Your account sits in one menu at the foot of the rail, with your Google picture.
